statement: Open-time policy discrepancy, SDL side: SDL Triton InitDevice registers wired controller with no feature GET exchange; on UpdateDevice active path it sends periodic 0x87 setting9=0, and on SetSensorsEnabled it sends 0x87 setting48=0x18 or0. Unlike Linux registration it does not issue feature serial/attributes request in this driver. Emulator must accept both consumer-specific call paths, not force kernel order on SDL. SDL:453-471,485-506,653-676.

applicability.scope: Host-consumer expectations differ; this is a source comparison, not a conflict between measured device captures. Common behavior and reconciliation are stated in claim.
